title: Museum of Glass

services.name: Take a Tour
services.desc: The Teen Docent Program is an educational initiative at Museum of Glass for high school students designed to expose those of diverse backgrounds to the inner workings of a museum and provide them with valuable professional development opportunities. Participants will be trained in the best practices of museum docent work, provided with in-depth information about each of the exhibitions currently on view in the galleries, and paired with docent mentors as they learn the skills needed to conduct exhibition tours for Museum of Glass visitors. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Located on the Thea Foss Waterway in downtown Tacoma, the Museum offers multiple spaces, both indoor and outdoor, as well as private access to the Museum’s galleries, creating an ideal setting for an unforgettable event. The Grand Hall is an impressive 6,900 square-foot space, perfect for receptions, formal dinners, or contemporary art programs and has ample space for dancing and musical entertainment. Northwest artist Cappy Thompson’s stunning glass triptych, Gathering the Light, a mythical interpretation of a glass-making world, is installed in the Grand Hall, offering an artistic backdrop for your event.
